notes: Pixel coordinates are measured against the original 2048x1365 source, never the resized chat preview. Only the large left front elevation is used; side, back, enlarged accessories, labels, and dimension arrows are excluded.

Headless torso silhouette, paired chest eyes, navel mouth, sun shield, axe openwork, waist beast buckle, and torn skirt are identity-critical. Chest eyes and mouth are surface artwork, not holes; only background-connected negative spaces in the axe and skirt should be opened.
The left axe is split into visible upper handle, lower handle, and pierced blade to prevent the hand artwork being baked into the axe. All three pieces share the Axe bone and overlap behind the hand.
The right hand is hidden by the front-view shield. No invented hand silhouette is added; the Shield bone is placed at the visible sun hub and parented to the visible forearm.
Shoulder, elbow, knee, and ankle centers are taken from drawn brass joints; hip pivots lie beneath the existing belt/skirt. Overlap by a few source pixels at joints is intentional.

Keep the legs planted in these three preview poses: the reference does not reveal full upper thighs behind the layered skirt. Large leg swings require drawn hidden extensions rather than stretching source pixels.
Use rigid single-bone weights for articulated leather-sheet pieces; do not smooth-skin across riveted joints. Back faces and cut edges should be leather colored.
The ornamental sun motif is not a through-hole; preserve the shield as a solid leather disc for a readable real shadow.

Run2: right calf outer boundary is clipped to the actual source silhouette at x707-710 around y758-778; this excludes the ankle-label arrow at y765-769 without trimming the leather leg. Reviewed against all five Run1 previews and the original 2048x1365 pixels.

provenance.method: Contour-modeled extruded leather pieces from existing project concept; real holes, rigid articulation, cleaned artwork UV atlas; no purchased mesh or new image generation.
provenance.texture_note: Stylized painted artwork, not a scanned physical albedo. Existing design-sheet markings are excluded.
